title: A gap between wetlands
hook: A habitat can become separated into patches.

knows: Animals have structures and behaviors that can be investigated.
doesNotKnow: The green corridor connects the two blue wetland patches in the stipulated model, so a route appears where the barrier previously blocked it. Real animals and landscapes differ: a corridor’s success requires separate evidence.

misconception: The evidence in the scenario supports a different interpretation.
objective: In this simple landscape model, frogs can move along wet habitat but cannot cross the dry barrier. What happens when a wet corridor joins the ponds?

Real animals and landscapes differ: a corridor’s success requires separate evidence.
